mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, lowering the present value of expected dividends and earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% for 3 consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering the cost of capital and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) above 1,500K for 3 consecutive months reduces aggregate demand, lowering expected corporate earnings and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 1,000K for 3 consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, increasing expected corporate earnings and reducing discount rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 for 3 consecutive months indicates weakening domestic demand, lowering expected corporate earnings and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1,300 for 3 consecutive months indicates a cooling housing market, reducing future economic growth prospects and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in cooling periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 305 for 3 consecutive months indicates disinflation, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in disinflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, increasing expected corporate earnings and compressing discount rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
